title: Safely managed drinking water, LDCs, LLDCs and SIDS compared with the World
headline: Safely managed water for all by 2030 needs a rise of 7.1 to 10.5 points a year in LDCs, LLDCs, SIDS
subtitle: Proportion of the population using drinking water from an improved source that is accessible on premises, available when needed and free from contamination
years: In LLDCs it has risen 0.4 points a year, from 26.3% in 2000 to 36.9% in 2024.
data_line: Data: WHO/UNICEF JMP via UN SDG Global Database, series SH_H2O_SAFE, extracted 1 Nov 2026
alt: Safely managed water for all by 2030 needs a rise of 7.1 to 10.5 points a year in LDCs, LLDCs, SIDS. In LLDCs it has risen 0.4 points a year, from 26.3% in 2000 to 36.9% in 2024. LLDCs: 0.4 a year observed, 10.5 needed; LDCs: 0.5 a year observed, 10.2 needed; SIDS: 0.2 a year observed, 7.1 needed; World: 0.5 a year observed, 4.4 needed
method: Method: linear pace on published aggregates, from 2000 for LLDCs.
question: Which LLDCs have moved safely managed drinking water fastest, and how?
